bandit_escape.description: Section 5 / Figure 3 100-armed bandit: risk-neutral policy remains near the local optimum while sufficiently risk-seeking policies converge to the global optimum.

expected_reward.description: Final policy probability-weighted reward over all 100 bandit arms.

mean_reward_last_1000.description: Average sampled reward over the final 1000 interactions, catching policies that look good only in the final distribution.

optimal_action_probability.description: Final probability assigned to the single globally optimal arm.

global_peak_probability.description: Final probability assigned to the high-reward global peak region.

global_peak_success_rate.description: Fraction of independent runs whose final policy reaches the global peak with high expected reward.

local_action_probability.description: Final probability assigned to the initially favored suboptimal arm.

local_peak_probability.description: Final probability retained in the local peak neighborhood, catching shortcuts that leave the exact local arm but stay in the local mode.
